item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 19/Sep/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong tomorrow morning. There will be a few showers over the region. The replenishment of the monsoon is expected to affect southern China towards the weekend. A broad area of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the northern part of the South China Sea and the Luzon Strait early next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Nanmadol will move across the coast of Honshu of Japan today and tomorrow, and evolve into an extratropical cyclone gradually.
